answers.question: Find the first name and age of students who have a pet.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT fname, age FROM student s JOIN has_pet hp ON s.stuid = hp.stuid

answers.question: What is the id of the pet owned by the student whose last name is 'Smith'?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT petid FROM has_pet JOIN student ON has_pet.stuid = student.stuid WHERE student.lname = 'Smith'

answers.question: For students who have pets , how many pets does each student have ? list their ids instead of names .
What is the last name of the student who has a cat that is 3 years old?
answers.generated_answer: select s.lname from student s join has_pet h on s.stuid = h.stuid join pets p on h.petid = p.petid where p.pettype = 'cat' and p.pet_age = 3

answers.question: Find the average age of students who do not have any pet .
answers.generated_answer: SELECT AVG(age) FROM student LEFT JOIN has_pet ON student.stuid = has_pet.stuid WHERE has_pet.petid IS NULL GROUP BY stuid

answers.question: How many countries does each continent have? List the continent id, continent name and the number of countries.
Which model of the car has the minimum horsepower?
What is the model for the car with a weight smaller than the average?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DISTINCT mn.model FROM car_names cn JOIN model_list mn ON cn.model = mn.model JOIN cars_data cd ON cn.makeid = cd.id WHERE cd.weight < (SELECT AVG(weight) FROM cars_data)
